end_to_end.expected: (1) Two tabs sharing storage: tab 1 shows the end prompt and tab 2 resumes the paused session and leaves the table (ending it with a report). Then 'End session and start' in tab 1 fails cleanly: the error is logged, the dialog closes, Start game has focus, no Table opens, the stored ended record and report are unchanged and the chosen players value is kept. The next Start game opens the Table at once. (2) With the end transaction held, the Table does not open until it commits, and the new session starts at 0 hands.

The next Start game shows 'Cash · 9 players · $4/$8 · Hand #1' with no prompt, and exactly one new unended session exists. (2) In both browsers, with my own hold armed on the end scope (given in a different order): while held, across 5 s of clock the dialog stays visible, Escape is ignored and the header count is 0. After release the header shows Hand #1, the only non-A session has handsPlayed [0], A has a string endedAt and the only report is for A. After hand 1 the new session has handsPlayed [1].

items.evidence: The acceptance test 'an already-ended session is not ended again' passes in npm test. It asserts ConstraintError, byte-identical sessions and reports, and the original endedAt for the no-report, 0-hand and with-report cases, and it fails against the base store. My holdout on fake-indexeddb passes: an ended 0-hand record is kept with its endedAt, endedAt:null still ends normally and returns a report, an absent id resolves null, and re-ending a just-ended session rejects ConstraintError with the report unchanged. The same holdout fails against the base store.

The acceptance test 'endPausedSessions rejects an already-ended confirmed session and changes nothing' passes: ConstraintError is returned, sessions are JSON-identical, C stays unended and there are no reports. Holdout on fake-indexeddb with 4 unended sessions A,B,C,D, where another connection ends C in the gap right after endPausedSessions reads all sessions: the call resolves with A's report and rejected=[ConstraintError]. B and D are ended at their updatedAt with reports, C keeps the other tab's endedAt and 2 hands with no report, and the reports are exactly A,B,D. The base store fails this check by overwriting C and adding its report. A confirmed id that was already ended rejects and leaves everything unchanged.

The e2e 'a failed end returns focus to Start game and keeps the chosen values' passes on chromium and webkit. It asserts 0 dialogs, Start game focused, 9 and $10 / $20 kept, no header after runFor(2000), stores unchanged and the console error. The two-tab holdout (a real cross-tab end rather than a seeded report) gives the same clean failure on both browsers, and the next Start game works.

The e2e 'the Table opens only after the paused session is ended' passes on chromium and webkit. While the end transaction is held it checks the dialog is visible, both buttons are disabled and there is no header. After release it checks the header text, polls the 0-hand session, then checks the same id at 1 hand, A ended and the single report. My own-hold holdout also passes on both browsers: 5 s held with no Table and Escape ignored, then a 0-hand session followed by 1 hand.

summary: All 5 SPEC items pass.
